requirements.requirement: A long-running background worker is running on node1 as a managed service named inventory-worker.
requirements.summary: No service state was captured. The only attempted inventory-worker status probe was rejected because the cluster lease had expired, and the after-executor snapshot was likewise unavailable.

requirements.requirement: The inventory-worker is confined so it can write only within /var/lib/inventory.
requirements.summary: There is no captured service configuration or behavioral write test demonstrating either permitted writes under /var/lib/inventory or blocked writes elsewhere.

requirements.requirement: The inventory-worker cannot gain new privileges.
requirements.summary: No service configuration, process properties, or behavioral privilege-escalation test was captured.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are indeterminate because the cluster expired before any implementation or task-specific verification could be observed. The captured evidence neither establishes nor directly disproves the required managed worker and sandboxing properties.
limitations: The cluster lease expired for every executor command and all after-executor lifecycle observations.
No direct evidence establishes the service's existence, running state, filesystem confinement, or no-new-privileges property.

The mandatory provider-wide node-restart protocol was not performed: only the fixed pre-executor boot identity was captured; there is no healthy pre-restart task state, restart acknowledgement, different post-restart boot identity, or recovered service/data state. This lowers confidence but does not change task functionality because restart persistence was not part of the public contract.
The unavailable after-executor snapshot prevents an independent check for final residue, failed services, socket exposure, or package damage.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were observed. Both terminal commands were read-only diagnostic probes and were rejected due to the expired cluster lease; neither contains a state-changing action. Consequently, there are no unnecessary mutations to classify as retained or reverted, although final residue could not be inspected.
